name: Indian Institute of Technology Madras
overview: IIT Madras is an autonomous statutory institute of national importance established under the Institutes of Technology Act. Renowned for world-class research, deep tech innovation park, and premier engineering programs.
facilities: Library, Supercomputer Center, Research Park, Olympic Swimming Pool, Hospital, High-speed Wi-Fi, Sports Complex

name: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay
overview: IIT Bombay is a globally acclaimed engineering and research institute situated in Powai, Mumbai. Renowned for top JEE cutoffs, cutting-edge laboratories, tech innovation incubator (SINE), and stellar placement outcomes worldwide.
facilities: Central Library, Supercomputing Center, SINE Incubator, Gymkhana, Swimming Pool, Hospital, High-speed Wi-Fi

name: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi
overview: IIT Delhi is situated in Hauz Khas and recognized as an Institute of Eminence. A leader in science and engineering research, global corporate tie-ups, and fostering world-class technology unicorns.
facilities: Central Research Facility, High-Performance Computing, Bharti Telecom School, Amphitheatre, Hostels, Hospital

name: Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani
overview: BITS Pilani is an Institution of Eminence known for student autonomy, zero mandatory attendance, 7-month Practice School (PS-II) industrial internships, and high-impact placement track records matching premier IITs. Admitted purely through BITSAT.
facilities: Iconic Clock Tower, High-tech Telepresence Classrooms, Birla Museum, Student Activity Centre, Sky Observatory, Central Library

name: International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad
overview: IIIT Hyderabad is India's premier computer science research institution with world-renowned AI, NLP, and Computer Vision centers. Offers exceptional placement ROI and competitive programming culture. Admitted via JEE Main mode and UGEE.
facilities: Kohli Center on Intelligent Systems, Advanced Computing Lab, Robotics Lab, Nilgiri Building, Amphitheatre, Modern Hostels

name: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli
overview: NIT Trichy is the top-ranked NIT in India offering world-class engineering, technology, and management programs with an outstanding national placement track record.
facilities: Central Library, Octagon Computing Center, Modern Labs, Multi-purpose Gymnasium, Hospital, Hostels

name: National Institute of Technology Karnataka Surathkal
overview: NITK Surathkal is a premier national institute situated along the Arabian Sea near Mangaluru. Known for top-tier computing facilities, marine engineering, dedicated campus beach, and excellent core/IT placements.
facilities: Private Beach, Central Computer Centre, Sea-facing Hostels, Modern Digital Library, Sports Pavilion, Health Centre

name: College of Engineering Guindy Anna University
overview: One of Asia's oldest engineering institutions, CEG is the main campus of Anna University known for top-ranking state merit students, subsidized tuition, and distinguished alumni.
facilities: Heritage Campus, Ramanujan Computing Centre, Central Library, Swimming Pool, Robotics Club

name: PSG College of Technology
overview: PSG College of Technology is an ISO 9001 certified autonomous engineering institution renowned for industry-institute collaboration, practical training, and robust campus placements.
facilities: Nanotechnology Research Centre, High-Performance Compute Cluster, Industry Collaborative Labs, Indoor Sports Stadium

name: SSN College of Engineering
overview: Founded by Dr. Shiv Nadar, SSN is an autonomous engineering institution set on an expansive Wi-Fi campus with exceptional placement records and strong student scholarship initiatives.
facilities: Central Library, Advanced Research Labs, 1000-seater Auditorium, Air-conditioned Seminar Halls, Cricket Ground

name: Thiagarajar College of Engineering
overview: Thiagarajar College of Engineering in Madurai is a premier state-aided autonomous college offering engineering programs focused on academic rigor, rural innovation, and industry placements.
facilities: Computing Facilities, Digital Library, Incubation Centre, Outdoor Sports Arena, Solar Power Grid

name: Coimbatore Institute of Technology
overview: CIT Coimbatore is an autonomous government-aided institution known for technical education, high GATE qualification rates, and strong campus recruitment by core engineering firms.
facilities: Modern Machine Shops, Computing Labs, Hostels, Tennis Courts, Student Innovation Labs

name: Vellore Institute of Technology
overview: VIT Vellore is an Institution of Eminence deemed to be university known for its flexible credit system (FFCS), international student exchange, and massive placement drives.
facilities: Smart Classrooms, Technology Tower, International Food Courts, AC Auditoriums, Swimming Pools
